AdditionalCompiledModules.Name: erlang-length-comprehension-filters
AdditionalCompiledModules.Source:
-module(length_comprehension_filters).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    L = make(32001,[]),
    [yes] = [yes || X <- [L,[a|tail],[]], length(X) =:= 32001],
    <<1>> = << <<1>> || X <- [L,[a|tail],[]], length(X) =:= 32001 >>,
    #{yes := 32001} = #{yes => length(X) || X <- [L,[a|tail],[]], length(X) =:= 32001},
    done.
make(0,A) -> A;
make(N,A) -> make(N-1,[a|A]).

AdditionalCompiledModules.Name: erlang-length-dynamic-patterns
AdditionalCompiledModules.Source:
-module(length_dynamic_patterns).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    L = make(32001,[]),
    Map = #{32001 => payload},
    #{(length(L)) := V} = Map,
    payload = V,
    Bits = <<0:32001,7:3>>,
    <<_:(length(L)),Tail/bitstring>> = Bits,
    <<7:3>> = Tail,
    Sequential = <<3:8,0:32001,7:3>>,
    <<Count:8,_:(length(L)),Last:Count>> = Sequential,
    3 = Count,
    7 = Last,
    {fallback,tag} = choose({tag,#{}},[a|tail]),
    done.
choose(Value,L) -> case Value of {A,#{(length(L)) := B}} -> {A,B}; {C,_} -> {fallback,C} end.
make(0,A) -> A;
make(N,A) -> make(N-1,[a|A]).

AdditionalCompiledModules.Name: erlang-length-guard-contexts
AdditionalCompiledModules.Source:
-module(length_guard_contexts).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    L = make(32001,[]),
    good = choose(L),
    bad = choose([a|tail]),
    good = case L of X when length(X) =:= 32001 -> good end,
    good = if length(L) =:= 32001 -> good; true -> bad end,
    good = alternatives([a|tail]),
    false = (false andalso length([a|tail])),
    true = (true orelse length([a|tail])),
    done.
choose(X) when length(X) =:= 32001 -> good;
choose(_) -> bad.
alternatives(X) when length(X) > 0; is_list(X) -> good;
alternatives(_) -> bad.
make(0,A) -> A;
make(N,A) -> make(N-1,[a|A]).

-module(length_long_badarg).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    Original = make(64001,tail),
    true = try apply(erlang,length,[Original]) of _ -> false catch error:badarg:Stack -> [{erlang,length,[Argument],_}|_] = Stack, Argument =:= Original end,
    fallback = guarded(Original),
    done.
guarded(X) when length(X) > 0 -> wrong;
guarded(_) -> fallback.
make(0,A) -> A;

AdditionalCompiledModules.Name: erlang-length-receive-scan
AdditionalCompiledModules.Source:
-module(length_receive_scan).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    L = make(32001,[]),
    self() ! skipped,
    self() ! {data,L},
    good = receive {data,First} when length(First) =:= 32001 -> good after 0 -> bad end,
    skipped = receive Remainder1 -> Remainder1 after 0 -> missing end,
    self() ! {data,[a|tail]},
    timeout = receive {data,Improper} when length(Improper) > 0 -> bad after 0 -> timeout end,
    {data,[a|tail]} = receive Remainder2 -> Remainder2 after 0 -> missing end,
    done.

    good = try throw(tag) catch throw:tag when length(L) =:= 32001 -> good end,
    good = maybe no ?= yes else ElseValue when length(L) =:= 32001 -> good end,
    true = try apply(erlang,length,[[a|tail]]) of _ -> false catch error:badarg -> true end,

-module(length_values).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    0 = length([]),
    4 = length([a,{b,c},[d],<<1:1>>]),
    true = bad([a|tail]),
    true = bad(not_a_list),
    0 = apply(erlang,length,[[]]),
    done.
bad(Value) -> try apply(erlang,length,[Value]) of _ -> false catch error:badarg -> true end.
